title: Compare actual canonical legacy and generic artifacts in the shared parity pipeline
description: Stage 2 reusable platform migration only. No standalone report, arbitrary SQL/joins, production database/deployment, secret/config edits or permission expansion; preserve concurrent work, all old routes and four-stage order. ERP331 only renders generic bytes and compares legacy input snapshots, so equal inputs can incorrectly pass output parity without any old artifact. Implement a bounded finite ILegacyReportArtifactSource and typed artifact DTO using existing canonical exporters. Decode actual old and generic Excel/PDF bytes and compare ordered headers, typed/null cells, formula-safe labels, original currency/unit labels and supported layout semantics. Never use the generic exporter as old exporter or a caller proof boolean. Missing legacy bytes/exporter/font, malformed or oversized output and unextractable formats fail closed. Wire actual artifact comparison into the existing evidence service, retain declared unsupported formats and all old routes.

Real executable tests cover matched and divergent results, missing source evidence, menu/column/data-scope revocation, raw null versus zero and segregated original currency/unit; actual SQL fixtures are guarded by dedicated LocalDB NEWERP_AutoAcceptance plus NEWERP_AUTOTEST_* database and integrated security. No fabricated environment pass.

Related existing API/provider/export tests and safe Release build/test pass with pipeline self-test and automation contracts. Preserve audit correlation and unrelated users/configurations. All-family migration and browser validation still required before route retirement.
